message:
feat(lk-ux-retry r1): the same connection presses 'Windows 로그인' again -- the earlier wait ends first, then the new password replaces the field

The 0.2.162 field case (10-22): a wrong password, then a second press was refused as 'still waiting'
until a reconnect. On top of the WIP 5b1d2e0 (service kind 9, relay retry op, host 89, viewer press):

- relay: the retry ends only the typed wait this pipe holds for THIS session, request AND tx generation;
  this session's typed wait being another request -> nothing asked. A service that answers but does not
  confirm keeps the earlier wait as it was (no pipe drop).
- every 'not ended / nothing asked' path answers SupersedeRefused (18): an unsupported service, a stale
  capability, no answer in time. The viewer keeps following the earlier wait on 18 and on no answer.
- the result window grows with its text: the fixed 64 px label cut the new retry guidance off
  mid-sentence (seen in the e2e capture). Never smaller than before; shared by every result window.

Tests: service lockcred +12 (supersede own/other/wrong id/already unlocked/untyped/old seal), relay
ondemand +18 against a fake service pipe (Busy for another session, refused keeps the wait, same
connection, silent service bounded, old service), e2e --lock-screen +13 (cancelled retry, retry typed
byte for byte, reconnect 0, typed twice, whole text visible). Mutants: old pending gate -> 7 FAIL with
the 10-22 text; fixed label -> FAIL. Section 3 (UIA failure detection) held: no real LogonUI evidence.

Numbers proposed for the verifier: 89, 0x80000, stage 17/18, IPC kind 9, feature 0x2.

제품/테스트/문서: 제품(relay·host 89 응답·뷰어 재시도·결과 창 크기) / 테스트(서비스·relay·e2e) / 문서(history·작업목록 LK·구현계획)
